name: Sign In with Password
summary: Authenticates an existing active user with a password and establishes the appropriate session while preserving deterministic rejected outcomes.

completionPredicate.expression: durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == password-proved and session-capability == authenticated-normal

coverageAssessment.rationale: The behavior is well understood in the implementation, but canonical AppUserTestScenario definitions for successful sign-in and rejected outcomes have not yet been created.
knownGaps: Locked, disabled, unverified, and step-up-required outcomes

sourceReferences.note: Password authentication behavior separated from password registration.
